verse.text: Didn’t the LORD make you one with your wife? In body and spirit you are his. And what does he want? Godly children from your union. So guard your heart; remain loyal to the wife of your youth.

reflection: Being a godly man isn't just about what you do for your kids — it starts with how you love and stay loyal to their mother. Malachi reminds us that faithfulness in marriage is the soil godly children grow out of; guard your heart there first, and the rest of your fathering flows from it. A dad who keeps his word to his wife is quietly teaching his children what covenant love looks like, every single day.
